Event Details What time should we arrive for the ceremony? Please arrive 10–15 minutes before the ceremony starts to find your seat. Is there a dress code? Semi-formal. Think suits, dresses, and cocktail attire. Travel & Accommodation Where should we stay? We recommend the Hillside Hotel and Lakeview Inn, both within 10 minutes of the venue. Is parking available at the venue? Yes, there is free parking available on-site for all guests. Gifts & Wishlist Do you have a wishlist? Yes, you'll find our wishlist on the dedicated page linked in the navigation. Can we give a cash gift? If you prefer, you're welcome to contribute to our honeymoon fund instead of a physical gift. Food & Dietary Requirements What type of food will be served? We'll be serving a three-course plated dinner with vegetarian
